DEPOSIT £1,800 - One bedroom ground floor furnished flat in the Morningside area of Edinburgh. TO BOOK A VIEWING PLEASE FILL OUT THE CONTACT AGENT FORM

The recently renovated ground floor property comprises an open-plan lounge/kitchen, one double bedroom with fitted wardrobes, and a shower room. Further benefits include double glazing, gas central heating, and free on street parking.  

Situated in the highly sought-after Morningside area, Morningside Gardens enjoys a peaceful residential setting while being just moments from an excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants, shops and supermarkets. The area is renowned for its village atmosphere, superb local schooling, and easy access to The Meadows, Blackford Hill, as well as regular transport links through the city centre and beyond.
